answer: Stop sybils with a beacon yarrow dune: an agent stakes a bond for one dune plot. Each cycle it plants yarrow and lights a beacon at the crest; verifiers match the roots to the flash, voiding a plot whose yarrow is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 plots at 17x each: each beacon flash fits one dune and one yarrow planting, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents plant and keep dune rights.
